selection_rule: question_selection.rs: deduplicate by entity ID; exclude seen/retired/invalid before selection; choose a positive-weight nonempty difficulty band then uniform stable SHA256 draw within band; unrated fallback only if no weighted rated band. Unconfigured policy picks smallest entity ID.
conditional_simulation: 100 fresh-task seed draws, easy-only weights, exact surviving batch as candidate pool. Pending entity IDs/order are unknown, so this demonstrates accessible choice-index support, not future learner-specific frequencies.
history_effect: Seen questions removed. Each surviving member has positive probability in weighted easy mode; learner history can reduce any subgroup. Policy and history not captured, so no universal future distribution asserted.

limits: Uses captured inventory; concurrent publication may change duplicates.
